notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. systemd guide: a hardened service unit, systemctl management, timers as a cron replacement, socket activation, dependency directives, cgroup v2 resource limits via drop-ins, journalctl analysis, and troubleshooting.

Following it can make the agent write unit files and drop-ins under /etc/systemd/system (SKILL.md:297-303), reload systemd, start/stop/restart/mask services, and vacuum journal logs (SKILL.md:340-342), all requiring root. Medium because these change system services and delete old logs; acceptable because they are standard, user-directed service administration on the user's own host and the sample unit enables sandboxing (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict) rather than weakening security.

The resource-limit example sets OOMPolicy=continue (SKILL.md:292), and troubleshooting suggests relaxing ProtectSystem/PrivateTmp only when namespacing fails (SKILL.md:352); neither disables SELinux or other host controls. Related Skills (SKILL.md:360-363) are named only and do not ship with this skill. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
